control: Device enrolment token bound to branch, rotated on re-enrol, revocable from admin

control: Password reset links single-use, 30 min validity, revoke other sessions on reset
MFA available for owner and admin; enforced when payments enabled
Generic error message for failed sign-in; no user enumeration

control: SSO tokens validated for issuer, audience, expiry, nonce
implementation_hint: openid-client library; no custom JWT parsing

control: Manager override records approver identity on the audit event
implementation_hint: approver_staff_id on OrderLine void, Discount, Refund

control: Sign-in flow has no cognitive puzzle (WCAG 3.3.8); PIN and passkeys allowed
implementation_hint: no CAPTCHA on staff login; rate limit instead

control: Passkeys offered for back-office users where the platform supports them
Service accounts use short-lived credentials from the platform vault
implementation_hint: no long-lived API keys in env for internal services

control: Session tokens generated by the framework with 128+ bits of entropy
Cookies httpOnly, secure, SameSite=Lax; __Host- prefix
Idle timeout 24 h for POS staff sessions, 30 d absolute for device tokens
Session invalidated on logout and on password or PIN change
Sessions list with revoke for back-office users
Shift-bound staff session ends at shift close on the device
Re-authentication (PIN) before refunds, voids over threshold and settings changes
Bearer tokens for devices never in URLs or logs

control: Object-level authorization: branch and organisation scope checked on every read and write
Function-level authorization for admin routes (/admin/*)

Role matrix stored server-side and synced to devices read-only
Cross-branch access only for owner roles via explicit branch switcher
Access decisions logged for denied attempts on money-moving operations
Authorization checks run server-side; UI hiding is not a control
All request bodies validated against a schema; unknown fields rejected

control: Numeric money inputs validated as decimal strings with minor-unit precision
Output encoding for HTML contexts; framework auto-escaping only
SQL only through the ORM or parameterised queries
File uploads: type allow-list, size cap, image re-encode, virus scan when public

control: Path traversal prevented on any file path derived from input
Receipt and kitchen ticket text sanitised for ESC/POS control bytes
Barcode scanner input treated as untrusted text (no key injection)

control: Deserialisation only of JSON; no eval or dynamic code from data
Query parameters for pagination bounded (limit ≤ 200)
TLS 1.2+ everywhere; HSTS with preload on the edge
Passwords Argon2id; PINs Argon2id with per-branch salt
Secrets in the platform vault; none in source, images or logs
Random values from CSPRNG (ids, tokens, receipt block nonces)
Device-local store encrypted at rest on tablets

control: Webhook signatures verified with constant-time compare
ZATCA cryptographic stamp keys stored per device in secure storage
implementation_hint: onboarding via CSID; keys never leave device

control: Card data never stored, logged or transmitted through the app (PAN, expiry, CVV)

Log retention 30 days; audit forever (financial retention)

Rate limits per device and per staff on money operations

Build reproducible from a clean clone with one command
